description: evals/records/<task>/<key>.json, written by make eval TASK=<task> MODEL=<id> and committed. With the model registry on, synth refuses a task whose eval names no passing record for its model family and settings (effort, thinking, max_tokens). Required checks by task: scheduler.plan: scenario_standard, scenario_hard; recommender: schema_valid, faithfulness, policy_violations, cost_per_rail; recommender.cohort: schema_valid, faithfulness, policy_violations, cost_per_rail; understanding.describe: schema_valid, categories_valid, expected_categories, no_wrong_categories, moderation_agreement, brand_safety_expected, cost_per_hour. The recommender's (schema_valid, faithfulness, policy_violations, cost_per_rail) include the deterministic faithfulness check: each tile's reason cites only facts of the input.
